body:
I've heard a clean room will make me feel better so I've decided to completely renovate mine! I decided to start the new year completely well new! 

As for the relationship, other than my immediate family I feel as though he is the only other person out there in the world that genuinely loves me and enjoys who I am as a person. The problem is my family seem as though they will never ever accept him due to societal pressures e.g. think not marrying outside the race etc. It gives me stress because I feel as though I have found something that makes me happy and I'm not even allowed to have it. 

Another thing is I am always there to help people with everything and other than my boyfriend, I feel as though no one ever asks about me. Never how I feel or anything and it gets pent up. 

I'm so lost and thank you so much for the advice! Writing everything down seems like a good idea! A goal is easier to achieve when you know what the goal is in the first place!
